name: crossword_fill
description: Fill a crossword grid (rows of '.', '#' and fixed letters) from a word list given in the input, by backtracking with the most-constrained slot first and forward checking, within a time limit. Returns the filled grid and numbered across/down entries, whether the fill is unique (with max_solutions above 1), or that no fill exists.

catalog.source: original; backtracking with the minimum-remaining-values heuristic and forward checking (Russell and Norvig, Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach, ch. 6)
